# w.scrpt 0.1.0 RC28 checkpoint

Date: 2026-07-28

Worktree: `/path/to/wscrpt`

## Scope

RC28 adds a bounded read-only Git Blame view for the active file's current line, giving the editor a compact authorship/history inspection route without leaving the keyboard-first IDE surface.

- `Esc v a` opens Git Blame for the active line.
- `:blame`, `:git-blame`, `:line-blame`, and `:blame-line` open the same view.
- The command scopes Git blame to the active file's current line using `git blame --line-porcelain -L line,line -- path`.
- The view shows repository path, commit, summary, author, author mail, author epoch time, original/current line numbers, blamed filename, and line content when Git reports them.
- Untitled or virtual buffers are refused before line blame can run.
- The view is read-only and cannot edit source text.
- The command runs directly through the existing bounded Git runner, never through a shell.
- It does not stage, commit, switch, pull, push, reset, tag, or discard working-tree content.
- The keymap reference, action footer, README, and iPad QA matrix expose the new blame route.

## Proof boundary

This checkpoint is locally verified on the host Rust/PTY path. It is not a real iPad Magic Keyboard, Blink Shell, mosh, SSH, tmux, clipboard, touch, reconnect, or real language-server proof. Those remain manual QA gates in `docs/IPAD_BLINK_QA.md`.
